from harness import *
fails = 0
def C(desc, wire, expected, **kw):
    global fails
    out = run(envelope([ev(kw.pop('t', 0), peer=kw.pop('peer', 'edge'), auth=kw.pop('auth', 'alice'),
                           egress=kw.pop('egress', 'internal'), wire=wire)], **kw))
    r = out['results'][0]
    got = r['reason'] if r['decision'] == 'reject' else 'OK'
    if got != expected:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL %-40s expected %-10s got %-10s' % (desc, expected, got))
    return r

def raw(*lines, body=b''):
    return ('\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n\r\n').encode('latin-1') + body
S = 'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'
STD = ['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']

C('uppercase compact L', raw(S, *STD[:4], 'L: 0'), 'OK')
C('mixed T and To', raw(S, STD[0], 'T: <sip:bob@lab.test>', STD[2], STD[3], STD[4], 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>'), 'headers')
C('header name with percent', raw(S, *STD, 'X% Weird*Name`: v'), 'OK')
C('header name with tilde', raw(S, *STD, "X~'!: v"), 'OK')
C('header name bracket', raw(S, *STD, 'X[y]: v'), 'syntax')
C('colon only line', raw(S, *STD, ': v'), 'syntax')
C('value with colon', raw(S, *STD, 'X: a:b:c'), 'OK')
C('unknown repeated ok', raw(S, *STD, 'X: 1', 'X: 2'), 'OK')
C('via ignored', raw(S, *STD, 'Via: SIP/2.0/UDP 1.2.3.4;branch=x', 'Contact: <sip:a@b.test>', 'Authorization: Digest username="x", response="y"'), 'OK')
C('remote-party-id ignored', raw(S, *STD, 'Remote-Party-ID: <sip:evil@x.test>;party=calling', 'P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>'), 'OK')
# privacy + from anon with PPI
r = C('anon from + id + ppi', raw(S, 'From: sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid;tag=t1', *STD[1:], 'P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@lab.test>', 'Privacy: id'), 'OK')
print('  ->', r['from'], r['identity'], r['pai'], r['privacy'])
# ANON is case sensitive in user part
C('anon user case differs', raw(S, 'From: SIP:Anonymous@ANONYMOUS.INVALID;tag=t1', *STD[1:]), 'identity')
C('anon host case folds', raw(S, 'From: SIP:anonymous@ANONYMOUS.INVALID;tag=t1', *STD[1:], 'Privacy: id'), 'OK')
# tel identities
C('ppi single tel external', raw(S, *STD, 'P-Preferred-Identity: tel:+12025550100'), 'OK', egress='external')
r = C('relay tel pai', raw(S, *STD, 'P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>'), 'OK', peer='trunk', auth=None)
print('  ->', r['account'], r['identity'], r['pai'])
# sips
C('sips from alias unknown', raw(S, 'From: <sips:alice@lab.test>;tag=t1', *STD[1:]), 'identity')
# body sha differs
r1 = C('body sha', raw(S, *STD[:4], 'Content-Length: 3', body=b'abc'), 'OK')
import hashlib
assert r1['body_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(b'abc').hexdigest()
# INVITE method with cseq INVITE
C('invite ok', raw('INVITE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0', 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 31337 INVITE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'OK')
C('invite cseq message', raw('INVITE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0', 'From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c1', 'CSeq: 31337 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0'), 'fields')
print('misc fails:', fails)
